entries.title: Psalms 62:1
segments: ¶<<To the chief Musician, to Jeduthun, A Psalm of David.>> Truly my soul waiteth upon God: from him [cometh] my salvation. {Truly: or, Only} {waiteth: Heb. is silent}

entries.title: Psalms 62:2
segments: He only [is] my rock and my salvation; [he is] my defence; I shall not be greatly moved. {defence: Heb. high place}

entries.title: Psalms 62:3
segments: How long will ye imagine mischief against a man? ye shall be slain all of you: as a bowing wall [shall ye be, and as] a tottering fence.

words.text: How long will ye imagine mischief
all of you: as a bowing
[shall ye be, and as] a tottering

entries.title: Psalms 62:4
segments: They only consult to cast [him] down from his excellency: they delight in lies: they bless with their mouth, but they curse inwardly. Selah. {inwardly: Heb. in their inward parts}

entries.title: Psalms 62:5
segments: My soul, wait thou only upon God; for my expectation [is] from him.

entries.title: Psalms 62:6
segments: He only [is] my rock and my salvation: [he is] my defence; I shall not be moved.

entries.title: Psalms 62:7
segments: In God [is] my salvation and my glory: the rock of my strength, [and] my refuge, [is] in God.

entries.title: Psalms 62:8
segments: ¶Trust in him at all times; [ye] people, pour out your heart before him: God [is] a refuge for us. Selah.

entries.title: Psalms 62:9
segments: Surely men of low degree [are] vanity, [and] men of high degree [are] a lie: to be laid in the balance, they [are] altogether [lighter] than vanity. {altogether: or, alike}

entries.title: Psalms 62:10
segments: Trust not in oppression, and become not vain in robbery: if riches increase, set not your heart [upon them].

entries.title: Psalms 62:11
segments: God hath spoken once; twice have I heard this; that power [belongeth] unto God. {power: or, strength}

entries.title: Psalms 62:12
segments: Also unto thee, O Lord, [belongeth] mercy: for thou renderest to every man according to his work.
